findings.claim: The LF-ending regression test does not enforce the spec requirement that every tracked text file reports `i/lf`.
findings.evidence: Spec scenario `Text is stored as LF` says every tracked text file must report `i/lf`, but the test only filters lines starting with `i/crlf`, so `i/mixed` or other non-`i/lf` text entries would pass.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse `git ls-files --eol` output and fail any tracked text entry whose index EOL field is not exactly `i/lf`, while excluding binary `i/-text` entries.

findings.claim: The change records verification tasks as incomplete for the local commit and owner notification steps.
findings.evidence: The diff leaves tasks 3.5 and 3.6 as `- [ ]`, while the change’s own task list requires committing locally with an `Assisted-by` trailer and telling the owner to re-run `/kbd-init --force`.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete and mark tasks 3.5 and 3.6 checked, or do not present the change as complete.
